selection: Fit train only, choose highest validation balanced accuracy; break ties by macro F1 then smaller C. Do not refit train plus val. Fit separate binary AI-versus-other and secondary three-class logistic models.
primary_endpoint: Observed ai_prompt_submit versus other observed actions, threshold 0.5; recall, specificity, balanced accuracy, AUROC and average precision.
secondary_endpoint: Three-class observed-action balanced accuracy, macro F1 and confusion.
history_fields: Allowlisted past-event counts at 1/5/15/60 seconds, source availability and capped time-since-last with missing indicator only. Cutoff, absolute time, participant, evidence row, action target, GPT events and content are excluded from estimator inputs.
missing_lag: Fixed cap 60 seconds plus explicit missing indicator; train-only scaling. No data-fitted or test-derived imputation.
context: Only predeclared previous page, AI availability and joint category through train-only DictVectorizer.
uncertainty: Paired participant-cluster percentile bootstrap on the same held-out subjects, conditional on the frozen selected fits. Report valid draws. Not multiplicity-adjusted confirmatory superiority evidence.
precision_scope: The enriched case-control sample only; no natural-population precision or false-actions/minute estimate.
handoff_proposed_estimator_note: Preparation handoff's C=1/unweighted estimator was explicitly a not-yet-implemented proposal. This separate analysis protocol freezes the requested validation-selected grid before the held-out baseline prediction pass.
